cs.t: Oh yes I remember that one. Wasn't it the type 4? The type 5 was a better mouse (with ball though) but as I remember the keyboard was a little worse.
cs.th: Restoring a Sun SPARCstation IPX Part 1: PSU and Nvram

cs.t: I've been wanting to get one for a PC mITX case mod. I love Sun's design language and the IPX cases are cute. I have got a Sun Type 5 keyboard though. I brought it to a mechanical keyboard meetup once, only to show it off because it is so pretty. Not the best key feel though, but I've got nothing to use it with.
